films.title: Troy
films.description: Petersen's epic makes Patroclus' death in Achilles' armor the film's emotional hinge — the friend that brings the hero back to war.

popCulture.title: Patroclus
popCulture.description: The companion who dies wearing Achilles' arms — Book XVI's fall that turns the Iliad toward vengeance.

popCulture.title: Iliad
popCulture.description: Hector's slaying of Patroclus remains the poem's central grief — the death that costs Troy its best defender.
